annotations.title: Calculators · First home buyer grants and concessions

description:
**What being a first home buyer is worth on one purchase**: every first
home grant in the state (eligible or not, and why), the stamp duty saving
against an ordinary owner-occupier, and the total.

**Who it's for:** first home buyers — Australian citizens or permanent
residents buying a home to live in, who have never owned a home in Australia.
Grants mostly go to new homes under a price cap; duty exemptions and
concessions mostly apply to established homes and land too, up to a cap.

**What it covers:** the First Home Owner Grant and any other first-home cash
grant the state pays, and the first home duty exemption / concession (via the
same rules as `/calculators/stamp-duty`, shown line by line in
`duty_breakdown`). For `vacant_land`, the grant is assessed as land bought to
build a new home on; the cap on land plus build is spelled out in `detail`.

**Caveats:** eligibility also depends on residence requirements (moving in
within a year and living there 6–12 months), every buyer's history and some
income tests — this answers on price, property type and date. Federal
schemes (deposit guarantees, super savings) are not included. See
`caveats`.

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

contract_date.description: Contract date (YYYY-MM-DD); picks the rates in force on that day. Default: today in Sydney.

dependants.description: Dependent children — raises an income-tested scheme's limit (ACT).

household_income.description: Gross household income for the past year — used by income-tested schemes (ACT). Omit and we assume you meet the income test.

off_the_plan.description: Bought off the plan. Changes the answer only where a state has an off-the-plan concession.

price.description: Purchase price in dollars (for vacant land: the land price).

property_type.description: `established` (an existing home), `new` (a new home or off-the-plan, never lived in), or `vacant_land` (land to build a home on).

regional.description: Outside the capital city (WA: outside Perth and Peel; also the WA grant's northern cap). Ignored where a state draws no such line.

state.description: State or territory: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT.
